Work.

Hey, I’m Trevor! I’m a sound designer, music producer, and composer with over 10 years of experience working across music, games, and interactive media.

I’ve previously contributed in-game music to VALORANT with Riot Games and recently worked with GOOD1 Studios on DEADLINE DELIVERY. I’m passionate about using sound to give projects a stronger identity, whether through sound design, music, implementation, or anything in between.

I have experience working with Unreal Engine 4 and 5, Unity, Wwise, FMOD, and other game audio tools, as well as extensive experience with Pro Tools, Ableton Live, and FL Studio.

I’m always looking to expand my skills, take on new challenges, and find creative ways to push audio further. If you’re looking for someone who can bring both technical experience and a unique creative perspective to a project, I’d love to connect and hear what you’re working on.

TECHNICAL AUDIO · DEADLINE DELIVERY

Velocity-driven Doppler system

I built the vehicle Doppler system in Unreal Engine 5, calculating motion relative to the player and sending the result to a Wwise RTPC for a responsive pitch shift.

In game

Pitch rises on approach and falls as the vehicle passes the listener.

Blueprint logic

Listener direction

Subtract car position from player position, then normalize the direction.

Relative velocity

Subtract player velocity from car velocity so both moving bodies affect the result.

Radial speed

Project relative velocity onto the listener direction with a dot product. The sign distinguishes approach from recession.

Wwise control

Scale and clamp the result from −10 to 10, then set the car’s Doppler RTPC with 150 ms interpolation.
